fullPassage: Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not depend on imitating the success of others. Failure does. Success does not arise from following in the path of someone else. Failure does. Why? Because you cannot be them, no matter how hard you try. At best, you can only imitate them. But an imitation is just a poor copy, it is never the real thing; it is fool's gold. The reflection in the mirror can never be the person standing before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no substance in a forgery. Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a pretense. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you. It must come from finding that which is successful in you and following your own path.

Everyone knows it ②<u>aren't</u> the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a pretense. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you. It must come from finding that which ③<u>is</u> successful in you and ④<u>following</u> your own path.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① imitating: depend on + 동명사 구조 — 올바름
❌ ② aren't: 주어가 it(단수)이므로 isn't가 올바름. aren't는 복수 주어에 사용
✅ ③ is: that which(= what, 단수 취급) + is — 올바름
✅ ④ following: come from + 동명사 구조에서 and로 finding과 병렬 — 올바름

det.analysis:

det.tip: 전치사(from, of, in, by 등) 뒤에는 명사/동명사. 동사원형 불가

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not depend on imitating the success of others.

(A) The reflection in the mirror can never be the person standing before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no substance in a forgery.

(B) Why? Because you cannot be them, no matter how hard you try. At best, you can only imitate them. But an imitation is just a poor copy, it is never the real thing; it is fool's gold.

(C) Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a pretense. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you.

det.analysis:
✅ ② (B)→(A)→(C): 모방의 이유와 한계(B) → 거울/위조 비유(A) → 결론: 진짜 자신이 되라(C)
❌ ① (A)→(B)→(C): 비유가 이유 설명 전에 나와 논리 역전
❌ ③ (C)→(A)→(B): 결론이 먼저 나와 논리 역전
❌ ④ (B)→(C)→(A): 결론 후 거울 비유가 와서 부자연스러움

det.analysis: ✅ successful: which is + 형용사 구조. success(명사) → successful(형용사: 성공적인)

questions.passage: Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not depend on __________ (imitate) the success of others. Failure does. Success does not arise from following in the path of someone else. Failure does. Why? Because you cannot be them, no matter how hard you try. At best, you can only imitate them. But an imitation is just a poor copy, it is never the real thing; it is fool's gold. The reflection in the mirror can never be the person standing before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no substance in a forgery. Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a pretense. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you. It must come from finding that which is successful in you and following your own path.
